proof_body:
by
  intro a δ hδ
  refine ⟨fun x => max 0 (1 - |x - a| / δ), ?_, fun x => le_max_left _ _, ?_, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  · exact continuous_const.max (continuous_const.sub (((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).abs).div_const δ))
  · simp
  · have h₁ : 1 ≤ |x - a| / δ := (one_le_div hδ).2 hx
    exact max_eq_left (by linarith)
target_source: ∀ (a δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous φ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x) ∧ φ a = 1 ∧ ∀ x, δ ≤ |x - a| → φ x = 0
